# Version 4.151.0
> **Managed performance pass** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 moves onto Skia m151 and ports several hot paths to allocation-free managed C#. A batch of performance PRs move color conversion, premultiply math, and HarfBuzz/font-tag parsing off native round-trips and onto zero-allocation managed code, plus new .NET 11 WASM support.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia bumped to milestone m151** — Updates the bundled Skia engine to m151 and folds in several rounds of upstream bug fixes merged during the preview cycle. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489))

## API Surface

- **Performance-focused managed rewrites** — SKColor↔SKColorF conversion, SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply, SKColor hex parsing, and SKShaper glyph reads move to allocation-free managed implementations with new ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385), [#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345), [#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388))
- **HarfBuzzSharp/font-tag parsing made allocation-free** — Buffer.AddUtf8(string) now pools its UTF-8 encode, and Tag.Parse/SKFourByteTag.Parse no longer allocate a char[4] per call. ([#4376](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4376), [#4408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4408), [#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native resource and CPU-raster regressions fixed** — SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) no longer leaks a native resource, unnecessary unsafe was dropped from GRContextOptions, and a legacy shader-context flag was restored to fix a CPU raster regression. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997), [#3991](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3991), [#4428](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4428))

## Platform

- **WASM gains .NET 11 and exception-handling coverage** — Adds Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries for .NET 11 and a preview-.NET WASM test job to catch exception-handling regressions early. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4487](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4487), [#4488](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4488))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Ships allocation-free Buffer.AddUtf8 and Tag.Parse implementations alongside the m151 engine bump.
